data.title: Order to remove green waste (Ordnungsverfügung)
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt's public order office ordered you to remove green waste dumped on the city green space behind your property at Lindenweg 12 by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city threatens substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) at an expected cost of €480.00.
data.explanation: The city says green waste was dumped on the city green area behind your property and orders you to clear it completely by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city may do the work itself and bill you, expected cost €480.00. You may also file a court action (Klage) at the administrative court; there is no prior objection step. The app shows the deadline for that. Consider getting legal advice if you think the order is wrong, for example if the waste isn't yours.

items.title: Remove green waste
items.action: Completely remove the green waste from the city green space behind Lindenweg 12.
items.consequence: The city threatens substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) at your cost, expected €480.00.
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026

items.title: Deadline to file court action (Klage)
items.action: Decide whether to file a court action at the administrative court, in writing or recorded at the court registry.
items.consequence: After the deadline the order can no longer be challenged.

date.text: binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
